svg.title: R-airlock-P - Airlock & EVA Prep - plan
svg.text: CLEAR: approach to the decontamination arch and a~
The airlock is where crew suit up for EVA and cycle through the hull hatch; it holds the suits, oxygen packs and
decontamination equipment and the interlock controls for the hatch.
EVA suit lockers and oxygen packs (south wall)
Airlock control console and O2 reserve (west wall, south of the door)
Tool belts (west wall, north of the door)
Decontamination shower and first aid (south-east corner)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 3 - ENGINEERING DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL +0.000
